from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Mark every complete, uniform row and column. These are the full-color
    # lines in the demonstrations; recolor their cells to 2.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            for c in range(w):
                out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
f=programs/'task-3ae5a415.py'; f.write_text(code)
ns={}; exec(code,ns)
